answer: The ledger keeps one lantern, the hash of the last admitted registration, and each sign-up must seed its sequential delay proof from it. Proofs are strictly serial and can't be precomputed or parallelized. Required squarings are 2^26 (about a minute) × tide, the all-time registration count, which never resets. At tide 3,000 one entry takes 50 hours, and 40 more fakes take about 84 days. Validators check each crystal proof in milliseconds.
